name: Duplicacy-Exporter
description: Prometheus exporter for Duplicacy backups. Collect real-time backup progress from logs or receive Duplicacy Web UI reports by webhook, with persistent metrics and an optional storage poller.

paths.name: Data Directory
paths.description: Persistent exporter state and last-seen log timestamp.

paths.name: Duplicacy Logs Directory
paths.description: Optional host directory containing the Duplicacy log. Required when Mode is log_tail and Log File is used.

paths.name: Docker Socket
paths.description: Optional Docker socket for direct container-log tailing. Clear Log File when using this. WARNING: Docker socket access is highly privileged.

paths.name: Poller Repositories Directory
paths.description: Optional parent directory containing initialized Duplicacy repositories used by the storage poller. Reference child paths under /repos in Poller Repositories JSON.

ports.name: Metrics / Webhook Port
ports.description: HTTP port for /metrics, /health, and the webhook endpoint.

variables.name: Mode
variables.description: Collection mode: webhook receives Duplicacy Web UI reports; log_tail parses a shared log file or Docker container logs.

variables.name: Machine Name
variables.description: Machine label fallback. Required in log_tail mode unless the log provides a machine name.

variables.name: Log File
variables.description: Log path inside the container for shared log-file mode. Clear this field to tail Docker container logs instead.

variables.name: Duplicacy Container Name
variables.description: Exact name of the Duplicacy container to tail when Mode is log_tail, Log File is empty, and the Docker socket is mounted.

variables.name: Snapshot ID
variables.description: Optional snapshot label for stock Duplicacy CLI logs that do not contain section headers or DUPLICACY_META.

variables.name: Webhook Path
variables.description: HTTP path that receives Duplicacy Web UI report_url POST requests.

variables.name: Storage Host Map
variables.description: Optional JSON object mapping storage hostnames or IP addresses to friendly labels, for example {"192.168.1.20":"nas"}.

variables.name: Tailscale Domain
variables.description: Optional Tailscale domain suffix to remove from storage host labels, for example example.ts.net.

variables.name: Replay Hours
variables.description: Hours of Docker log history to replay when direct Docker log tailing starts.

variables.name: Maximum Log Buffer
variables.description: Maximum partial Docker log buffer size in bytes before incomplete data is discarded.

variables.name: Log Level
variables.description: Logging verbosity: DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, or ERROR.

variables.name: Persist Metrics
variables.description: Persist the last completed backup, storage, and prune values so they survive restarts.

variables.name: State File
variables.description: Metric-state file inside the container. Keep this under the mapped Data Directory.

variables.name: Enable Storage Poller
variables.description: Enable Duplicacy list/check polling for storage-size and revision metrics. Requires initialized repositories and credentials.

variables.name: Poller Repositories
variables.description: JSON list of repositories, for example [{"path":"/repos/photos","storage":"default","snapshot_id":"photos"}].

variables.name: Poller Interval
variables.description: Seconds between storage-poller cycles. The default is 24 hours.

variables.name: Poller Timeout
variables.description: Per-command timeout in seconds for Duplicacy list and check operations.

variables.name: Duplicacy Binary
variables.description: Duplicacy executable used by the storage poller. The upstream image bundles this binary.
